slides.s: Engineering Leader | 21 Years in Software, DevOps & AI-Driven Transformation
slides.n: Please welcome {name}, a PMP-certified engineering leader with 21 years of experience spanning software development, testing, DevOps, and technology leadership. {His} career reflects a steady rise from hands-on QA engineering to leading large-scale engineering organizations driving AI-enabled transformation.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul 2025-Sep 2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, drove a security-hardening initiative reducing 100+ long-lived defects and CVEs, and cut product upgrade time by ~90% through engineering transformation.

Cisco Systems India · Mar 2020-Jul 2025 — Led architecture and delivery of distributed Webex Calling/Meetings-Microsoft Teams integration services using Kafka, Redis, Java, and TypeScript/React, and drove AI-driven code generation initiatives for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2018-Feb 2020 — Led development of Cisco Expressway VoIP gateway platform and release/CI-CD engineering using Bitbucket, Jenkins, Kubernetes, and Docker, successfully delivering 10+ major and 30+ minor product releases.

Cisco Systems India · Apr 2008-Feb 2018 — Led QA automation and test strategy for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway VoIP platforms using a proprietary Python framework, mentoring QA teams and driving Agile adoption.
Verizon India · May 2007-Mar 2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow and regression testing for IP-converged contact center solutions covering IVR, call routing, and prepaid dialing.
slides.n: {His} journey began in hands-on QA roles at Verizon and Cisco, where {he} built deep expertise in VoIP testing and automation. Over time {he} grew into technical leadership, managing release engineering and CI/CD pipelines, before stepping into engineering management roles at Cisco and F5, where {he} now leads AI-driven transformation initiatives across control plane and cloud services.

{Name}'s skillset blends deep technical foundations in Python, Java, and VoIP protocols with modern DevOps and cloud practices. In recent years {he} has built strong expertise in AI and GenAI technologies, including LangChain, RAG pipelines, and Agentic AI, which {he} now applies to accelerate engineering delivery.

Across {his} career, {name} has consistently delivered measurable impact — from reducing product upgrade time by roughly 90 percent to resolving over 100 long-standing customer defects and CVEs, while successfully shipping dozens of major and minor product releases.

{Name} continually invests in {his} own growth, from earning a PMP certification to completing a postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Texas at Austin, building on {his} foundational engineering degree from Barkatullah University.

That brings us to the end of {name}'s story — a journey from hands-on QA engineering to leading AI-driven engineering transformation. Thank you for taking the time to learn about {his} career and accomplishments.
